name: Uruha
source:
Saeka's daughter.
She herself leads one of the exorcist swordsman squads.

Not only is she beautiful, but she also inherited her mother's earnest and serious personality. She deeply respects her mother, the strongest exorcist swordsman, and looks up to her as her goal.
